decision.explanation: Both awards are directly stated in the provided sources as having been received by Manuel Estrada Pérez. D1S2 explicitly states that he received the Medal of Francysk Skaryna from Belarus, while D2S2 confirms he received the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland from Finland. Neither source contradicts the other, and both refer to the same individual receiving distinct awards from different countries. These are separate, valid answers.
